title: ci(ui-merge): register `Lint UI` and `Build & E2E UI` in REQUIRED_CONTEXTS
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoVor7wZeUGoT2cwA6ZNospy)_
Fixes #25853

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of #25752 (cutover step 6, the repo half). Part of #25677.

**Tier H.** The registry's own exclusivity rule (`statesTheSet`) forces the AGENTS.md merge-queue sentence to name the registry exactly, so this PR touches `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/**`. `check-governed-merges --test` reads GOVERNED, landing tier H(人合). Draft; the seat lands.

## What changed

- `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`: two `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` rows in the shape of the existing five.
  - `ci.yml` job `lint-ui` publishes `Lint UI`; `carries`: the ESLint + repo-gate family of the `ui/` workspace.
  - `ci.yml` job `build-e2e-ui` publishes `Build & E2E UI`; `carries`: the Console build from `ui/apps/console` and its Playwright e2e.
  - `authorized` on both: #25752 step 6, the maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-26T00:25Z in the director thread, verbatim 「加上了」.
  - The two `statesTheSet` surfaces' `mustName` arrays (AGENTS.md, `platform-readings.md`) gain the same two literals; the history comments read 5→7 by #25853.
- `AGENTS.md` merge-queue sentence: "five contexts block" becomes "seven", naming `Lint UI` and `Build & E2E UI`, with "those five" → "those seven" twice. Line-neutral at headroom 0: the five lines are re-filled in place, no clause dropped, no ceiling raised. 1117 lines before and after; the widest touched line is 102 bytes.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`: the objectstack required-checks reading goes 五个 → 七个 with the two names. Line-neutral: 460 lines before and after, widest touched line 82 bytes, under the 120-byte cap.

Both new contexts' jobs keep the same `if:` the cutover gave them; when a PR does not touch `ui/` they conclude `skipped`, which satisfies a required check. Assertions 1–9 hold for both rows (same workflow as `Test Core` / `Build Core`, no matrix, no `continue-on-error`, `merge_group:` present, unfiltered `pull_request:`).

Not added, per the card: `Type Check UI` (waits for bill item 49) and `Test UI` (ruled out at the sitting, item 30 B).

## Verification (head aaf6226292)

- `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` → exit 0: `7 required context name(s) pinned across 3 workflow(s); 6 instruction surface(s) scanned`.
- `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 174 assertions.
- `NODE_OPTIONS=--use-env-proxy node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --verify-required-set` on the branch:

```text
required-set sweep: 7 live required context(s) on main, 0 registered-but-not-required, 0 required-but-unpinned.
  read 1 ruleset(s); 1 active and covering the default branch; strict_required_status_checks_policy: false
    • ruleset main (id 12119582, Repository-sourced — objectstack-ai/objectstack)
    required: TypeScript Type Check
    required: Test Core
    required: Build Core
    required: Lint & Repo Gates
    required: Governed Surface Queue Guard
    required: Lint UI
    required: Build & E2E UI

  ✅  the live required set and this registry agree in both directions.
```

- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 44 commands, all exit 0 on aaf6226292 after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build`; `--ran` reconciles 44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Other registry readers checked: `check-aggregator-roster.mjs` keeps its own aggregator subset and neither new job aggregates (`needs: filter` only), so no roster row is owed. `check-governed-merges`, `check-governed-queue-guard` and `ci-failure.mjs` mention the registry in prose only; their self-tests are in the derived list above.
- Changeset: none. Every path is repo-root tooling or instruction text and ships in no package (`skip-changeset` declared with the PR).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** 把你在割接当晚加进 `main` 规则集的两个必过检查 `Lint UI`、`Build & E2E UI`,登记进仓库里的必过检查注册表；同时把 AGENTS.md 和 pm-dispatch 读数表里“五个必过检查”的那句话改成七个，名单逐字对上。

**为什么改:** 注册表的作用是：有人改了 CI 里这两个 job 的名字，门禁会立刻变红，而不是让所有 PR 永远卡在“等待检查”。没登记之前，这两个检查只在设置里存在、仓库里没有任何东西守着它们的名字。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 只改登记和说明文字，不改任何 CI job 本身，不影响构建结果。回滚即 revert 本 PR；不需要动规则集设置。

**席位意见:**

**你要做的:** 审阅后批准合并（os-zhuang 审批即可）。规则集那一半你已经做完，无需再动设置。
